January 18, 2024


Yael Maman, Director of Marketing Communications, talks about Gilat’s transformative rebranding process, the reasons behind the rebrand, and how we created our new brand. At its core is our vision and mission, and our passion for making a profound impact on the lives of people and organizations everywhere on the planet.
